notes: The proof unjustifiably replaces the given series by series including the zeroth terms. The positive-index restriction of a zero-based enumeration need not cover the support. Take I=J=K={0,1,...}, v_0=1, all other v_i=0, r=1, j_n=n, and k swapping 0 and 1. The stated j-series sums to 0, while the k-series sums to 1, disproving the equivalence with r>0. Acknowledging this issue and reinterpreting the series proves a different statement.
